Footer.title: IIIF Kasane
Footer.description: A viewer that layers 3D models, images, audio, video and annotations, based on the IIIF Manifest.
Footer.developers: Satoru Nakamura & Jun Ogawa (The University of Tokyo)

News.heading: News
News.item6Title: Published a video introducing the compare page (comparing two models side by side, with a swipe, or through a spyglass; sharing by URL; the collapsible side panel)
News.item3Title: Richer annotation display: grouping of annotations on the same region, keyed tags and creators, search and filters, and a fix for flying to annotations without a camera
News.item7Title: Renamed to IIIF Kasane and moved to kasane.ldas.jp: besides 3D, it now shows image manifests and IIIF Cookbook recipes
News.item8Title: Image layers: show or hide each painted image, change opacity and stacking order, play the layers in or out one by one, and compare image Choices on the compare page
News.item9Title: New use cases and search pages: examples of what the viewer is for, search across collections and curations, and support for the IIIF Curation API
News.item10Title: More IIIF Cookbook recipes: v4 captions, images, styles and Wikidata in annotations, choosing a playable audio/video format, content states spanning several manifests, and a timeline view of Collections
News.item11Title: Support for images behind login or consent (IIIF Auth 2.0): images are blurred until access is granted, and a Wellcome Collection example is in the use cases
News.item12Title: More maps: a Map tab in the side panel, georeferencing for manifests whose points sit on the image, and placing georeferenced pictures over the map
News.item13Title: New Inference tab: runs NDL Kotenseki OCR-Lite and NDLOCR-Lite in your browser to read the text of the image on screen. The image is never sent anywhere

Home.developerNames: Satoru Nakamura & Jun Ogawa (The University of Tokyo)
Home.title: IIIF Kasane
Home.subtitle: A viewer that reads IIIF Manifests and layers 3D models, images, audio, video and their annotations in a single view. It started as a 3D viewer and now handles IIIF resources in general (formerly IIIF 3D Viewer).
Home.feature1Description: Rotate and zoom GLB models and point clouds with mouse or touch. Supports the initial view set in the manifest and switching between models placed at the same position.
Home.feature2Description: Deep zoom into IIIF Image API images. Rotated images and Canvases composed from multiple images are displayed as well.
Home.feature3Description: Play audio and video with captions and a time-aligned transcript alongside. Canvases that combine multiple media can also be played.
Home.feature4Description: Annotations on points of 3D models, regions of images and times in audio or video are layered over the resource. Annotations on the same region are grouped, with tags, search and filtering.
Home.feature5Description: Compare two models side by side, or overlaid with swipe and spyglass. Resources with location data are shown together with a map.
Home.feature6Description: Supports tables of contents, paging, two-page spreads and Collections. Share the open resource and position by URL, and embed the viewer in other sites with the iiif-viewer custom element.
Home.step1: 1. Enter the URL of an IIIF Manifest in the form below.
Home.step2: 2. Click the "Open Viewer" button to display the resource.
Home.step3: 3. Rotate and zoom 3D models and images, or play audio and video, with mouse or touch controls.
Home.step4: 4. Annotations, if any, are layered over the resource; click one to see its details.
Home.specP4Note: 3D Scenes, PointSelector and WktSelector targets, and camera annotations.
Home.specP3Note: Converted to the 4.0 form on load.
Home.specImageNote: Used for deep zoom, rotation and thumbnails.
Home.specContentStateNote: The iiif-content parameter selects the resource, Canvas and region to open.
Home.specGeorefNote: Used by the map viewer. The format, defined for 2D images, is extended to 3D coordinates.
Home.specRegionTagTitle: Shared Region and Keyed Tag Extension (own extension, draft)
Home.specRegionTagNote: Groups annotations that target the same region, and shows the label of a tag as its key.

cookbook.title: Cookbook samples
cookbook.lead: Recipes from the IIIF Cookbook. Use “Open in viewer” to check that each one displays in Kasane.
cookbook.videoLead: A video of every recipe opened in Kasane in turn. Use the chapters to jump to a recipe.

own.title: Kasane samples
own.lead: Test manifests made for this site. They cover uses the Cookbook does not, such as annotations on 3D models and timed transcripts.

UseCases.title: Use cases
UseCases.lead: Examples of Kasane with real collections. Watch the video, then open the same material with “Open in Kasane”.

Search.title: Search a collection or curation
Search.lead: Enter the URL of a IIIF Collection or a Curation (Curation API) to browse its contents with metadata facets. For a Collection, each Manifest is read to gather its metadata.
Search.inputLabel: URL of a Collection or Curation
Search.privacy: Everything is fetched and aggregated in your browser; no URL or image is sent to a server. Servers without CORS support cannot be read.
Search.error: Could not load it. Check that the URL is a Collection or a Curation and that the server supports CORS.
Search.failed: {count} manifests could not be read (they have no metadata or thumbnail)
